style: Refine every catalog object toward warm, softly lit cartoon art, consistent with the selected plant reference. Preserve identity, function and original palette family. Keep registered camera, dimensions, roots, sockets, ports, footprints and animation timing. No preferred horizontal light direction for rotatable world sprites; no directional ground shadows. Real 3D render output, editable Blender sources. The source 2D effects remain explicitly identified as 2D. Each object receives fresh independent editor/judge agents. Publish object-by-object to the same PR preview; integrate approved sprites into Godot after catalog review checks. Follow-on design exploration: improve the modeling itself, including forms, proportions, structure, crafted details and decorations. Original part counts and awkward geometry are not constraints. The editor may rebuild native geometry to achieve the better design; the judge should reward useful improvements. Preserve the locked registration, gameplay contact/clearance, animation and modular continuity contract. See modeling-policy.json version2.

highlighted.mechanism: Each native component scales about its own original pivot by1+0.008*sin(2*pi*(frame-1)/12). No location or rotation change, no shader/visibility change.
highlighted.proposal: Keep same phase, amplitude and smooth wrap. Rebuilt surfaces/details inherit a declared semantic owner; do not add a color blink, root bob or alpha effect. Scale multiplier tolerance0.0005; source-equivalent closure in evaluated driver transforms within1e-6.

clearance.mechanism: At t=(frame-1)/11 each original role scales uniformly1-0.9t, translates radially outward byup to0.7t along its original XY direction, lifts on a sin(pi*t) hump with role-index amplitude0.2+0.04*i, and applies signed local Z yaw[-1.7t,0,+1.7t] by original role cohort. Pivots are part-local, not one assembly-scale trick. Actual per-role samples and exact curve bytes are preserved in raw audit.

criteria.desiredVisibleOutcome: The sofa reads as intentionally designed upholstered furniture: soft generous cushion volume, gently compressed seats, comfortable arm/back transitions, credible support and an integrated wood understructure. Discarded character remains visible. Improve the hard slab/source construction natively; old silhouette microdetails, mesh counts and exact vertices are not locks.
criteria.evidence: Four registered idle facings at native/logical/phone sizes; full body and underside/side transitions examined at enlarged size. Rear/side volumes must be coherent native continuations of the S view.

criteria.desiredVisibleOutcome: Retain faded rose upholstery, cream replacement seat and warm brown wood/rubbish palette relationships. Warm and richer does not mean uniformly orange, over-saturated candy color or loss of the replacement-seat contrast.
criteria.evidence: Same scene/material setup across all facings and phases, shown on light/gray/dark and registered cream floor.

criteria.desiredVisibleOutcome: Soft broad highlights clarify cushioned convexity; shaded cloth, wooden base and folds stay readable without dead black bands, harsh facet steps or blown rims. Lighting has no preferred horizontal direction and casts no directional floor shadow.
criteria.evidence: One fourfold symmetric or horizontally invariant native light treatment, same camera/materials in all facings. No per-view recolor or fitting. Native light/shader record accompanies pixels.

No demand for exact target stitch/stain count.
